project: Wuxia Life P125 Full Stats Panel Martial Role Clarification
description: Explanation-layer experience slice: clarify the roles of martialPower, externalSkill, internalSkill, qinggong, and constitution in the full stats panel without changing the underlying combat system or removing any fields.

userStories.title: Lock full stats panel explanation scope
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the full stats panel explanation scope locked before rewriting labels or descriptions, so this stage stays on wording and grouping rather than drifting into system changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Document the current full stats panel surfaces in MainScreenStatsPanel.vue and buildFullStatGroups in src/components/mainScreenModel.ts
Confirm this stage only changes grouping, ordering, or explanation text in the full stats panel
Do not modify first-screen coreStats, tendencySummary, event logic, or attribute calculations in this stage (PRD §4 Out of Scope, §7 Non-Goals)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PRD §3 Core Problem and §4 Scope. This is the guardrail story so P125 does not absorb P123 or P124.

userStories.title: Clarify martialPower as the overall martial readout
userStories.description: As a player, I want the full stats panel to clearly tell me that martialPower is my overall martial readout, so I stop treating every combat-related number as an equal top-line bar.
acceptanceCriteria: The full stats panel clearly describes martialPower as the overall martial or total combat readout
After the change, martialPower no longer reads like just one co-equal row among five martial branches
No attribute values, formulas, or event dependencies are changed
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implements PRD US-001 and FR-2. Keep this to explanation-layer work only.

userStories.title: Reframe externalSkill, internalSkill, and qinggong as specialization dimensions
userStories.description: As a player, I want the combat sub-stats to read like style or specialization dimensions, so they feel like flavorful differentiation instead of co-primary growth axes.
acceptanceCriteria: Descriptions for externalSkill, internalSkill, and qinggong are revised toward specialization, style, or tactical-dimension language
These descriptions no longer imply each field independently explains total combat power
The panel still shows all three fields and their values after the change
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implements PRD US-002 and FR-3. Do not turn this into field removal or combat-system redesign.

userStories.title: Separate constitution from martial specialization language
userStories.description: As a player, I want constitution to read like survival foundation instead of another martial technique branch, so the full panel better reflects how the stat actually functions.
acceptanceCriteria: Constitution's full-panel wording or grouping better aligns with survival, recovery, endurance, or resilience
Constitution no longer reads like one more combat-style specialization adjacent to externalSkill/internalSkill/qinggong
No new stat categories or help system are introduced beyond the minimum grouping or description adjustment
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implements PRD US-003 and FR-4. This is the minimum reclassification at the explanation layer.

userStories.title: Add narrow verification for full-panel role clarification
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want targeted verification that the full stats panel now communicates total readout versus specialization versus survival base, so later copy edits do not collapse the distinction again.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update narrow verification covering martialPower's total-readout wording
Verification confirms externalSkill, internalSkill, and qinggong remain present but read as specialization-style dimensions
Verification confirms constitution reads as survival base rather than pure martial branch
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Implements PRD §9 Verification Standard. Keep the regression surface narrow and panel-focused.
